Summary Collaboration Themes: This collaboration bridges the technical rigor of software security and AI integrity with the social science insights of pain, exclusion, and DEI in higher education. By applying Maiti’s empirical auditing and data governance frameworks to Carter-Sowell’s research on social modulation of pain and structural barriers, the partnership aims to develop ethical, inclusive, and safe AI systems for academic environments. Key themes include mitigating algorithmic bias, understanding the physiological and psychological impacts of AI interactions on minoritized scholars, and creating robust, ethically grounded data stewardship practices for social science research.
